name: comp-27
blurb: Search input that shows a spinning loader when text is entered.
description: A search field with a magnifying glass that becomes a spinning LoaderCircleIcon on input. A mic button on the right for voice search. Loading state is simulated with useEffect.
use_when: Search forms that need visual feedback during a query, with voice input as an alternative.
avoid_when: The loader timing doesn't match your actual API call duration (500ms is hardcoded).
a11y: Label linked to input. Loader has role='status' and aria-label. Icons marked aria-hidden where appropriate. Mic button has aria-label.
